name: MUSE (Memory-Utilizing and Self-Evolving)
institution: KnowledgeXLab (academic research group; senior authors incl. Shanghai AI Lab) [uncertain]
what_evolved: Context记忆与提示 (hierarchical Memory Module M = {M_strat, M_proc, M_tool}; no model weight updates, evolution is purely in-context memory accumulation)
skill_as_artifact: Yes — experience stored as reusable memory artifacts of three forms: <Dilemma, Strategy> key-value pairs (strategic), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents (procedural), and static tool descriptions + dynamic usage instructions (tool)
skill_encoding: 自然语言 / 结构化文档 (natural-language key-value pairs and SOP docs; NOT executable code, NOT vector embeddings)
skill_granularity: Hierarchical across three levels: strategic (high-level insights/strategy), procedural (sub-task workflow SOPs), tool-use (atomic single-tool action instructions)
how_method: rollout_optimization (non-gradient, text-space) — agent's own interaction trajectories are distilled into textual structured memory via a Reflect Agent; no SFT, no RL reward
learning_signal_source: 自我反思 + 成败轨迹 (self-reflection on own trajectories; Reflect Agent emits success/failure flag via 3-axis verification)
reward_granularity: hybrid (process-level per-sub-task reflection signals + task-level outcome at full-task completion)
learning_paradigm: online; on-policy (learns from the agent's own live execution trajectories during deployment)
when_evolve: both intra-test-time (Plan-Execute-Reflect-Memorize loop runs during each task) and inter-test-time (accumulated memory persists and is reused across subsequent tasks)
trigger: 事件触发 (event-triggered: Reflect Agent fires after each sub-task for M_proc; full task completion triggers global M_strat/M_tool update + consolidation); also failure-triggered retries
library_structure: 层次化 (hierarchical 3-tier: Strategic / Procedural / Tool); Procedural indexed two-level by application (platform/API) then SOP index
retrieval_method: mixed: M_strat & static tool descriptions pre-loaded into system prompt; M_proc uses lightweight SOP index loaded at startup + on-demand tool-based (a_mem) retrieval of full SOP content; tool-dynamic instructions returned inline with observations
validation: execution-based + LLM-judge (Reflect Agent: Truthfulness Verification, Deliverable Verification, Data Fidelity, via trajectory reference and active verification against environment)
error_correction: self-revision (one retry per failed sub-task guided by failure-cause report; M_proc not forced during retry to encourage exploration) + dynamic re-planning of remaining sub-task queue
test_env: 通用 productivity (multi-app: browser, code interpreter, shell, vision extractor) evaluated on TheAgentCompany (TAC) benchmark
backbone_model: Gemini-2.5 Flash (primary, lightweight); also evaluated with open-source DeepSeek-V3-250324
where_deploy: general (real-world productivity task automation across HR / PM / coding / web apps)
metrics: success_rate (S_partial partial-completion, S_ckpt checkpoint-completion), generalization (zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks), sample_efficiency (memory accrued from only ~10% of tasks)
key_results: New SOTA on full TAC (175 tasks): avg S_partial 51.78%, first to break 50%, ~20% over prior SOTA (Openhands-versa w/ Claude-4 Sonnet) using only Gemini-2.5 Flash; continuous learning on T_cl: >10% gain over no-memory baseline after 3 iterations; zero-shot generalization on T_hard: S_partial 23.65% -> 33.41% with fixed accumulated memory; memory is model-agnostic (transfers to DeepSeek-V3 with gains)
limitations: transferability limited on advanced planning / multi-hop search tasks; not a replacement for fine-tuning on specific task types [uncertain]; authors note TAC benchmark has ambiguous task descriptions and rigid evaluation scripts; scalability of memory consolidation to very long task streams not deeply studied [uncertain]
